result.quote: They know we are starving, so they have left the camp to hide in the field, thinking, ‘When they come out of the city, we will take them alive and enter the city.’
result.reason: The king believes the Arameans left their camp to hide, capture the starving Israelites when they emerged, and enter the city. The key accurately paraphrases this plan as an ambush intended to take the city.
